## Names

<a id="room_map_00"></a>
### [`room_map_00`](../../../src/room_maps_00_04.asm#L18) `$68F9-$6A08`

*data*

Room maps, one per room 0-19 (pointer tables room_map_ptr_lo / room_map_ptr_hi, indexed by room), decoded by draw_room (draw_room_next_code). Each map is a run-length stream of 440 tiles = 11 rows of 40 tiles, drawn from screen row 3: c = $01-$7F: repeat the next byte c times; c = $81-$FF: copy the next c-$80 bytes; c = $80: end of the map. (c = $00 would repeat 256 times; no map uses it.) A tile is 2 characters high: bits 0-6 = character n on the upper screen row, n+$80 on the row below. Bit 7 set = the tile's colour RAM becomes $F8 (multicolour, black) instead of the room colour from room_colour_fill (map_tile_set_black). The charset is chosen by room: rooms 0-9 charset_rooms_0_9, 10-17 and 19 charset_rooms_10_19, 18 charset_wizard. room10_frame_protection_check writes $80 to the first byte of the maps of rooms 0, 1 and 5 when D6510 ($00) is not $EF, which empties them. Map of room 0, $68F9-$6A08 (272 bytes). Charset: room_charset_a (charset_rooms_0_9, D018 $38).

- **Written by:** [`room10_frame`](room_frames_8_11.md#room10_frame) [`$3CB1`](../../../src/room_frames_8_11.asm#L309)

<a id="room_map_04"></a>
### [`room_map_04`](../../../src/room_maps_00_04.asm#L197) `$6E1B-$6F81`

*data*

Map of room 4, $6E1B-$6F81 (359 bytes), RLE stream (format at room_map_00). Charset: room_charset_a ($A000, D018 $38). It decodes to 442 tiles, 2 more than 40x11: the extra $00 tiles land on $8FE8-$8FE9 and $9010-$9011 (bottom half $80), which corrupts 2 bytes of the collision mask of Bruce frame 0.

- **Entry of:** [`room_map_ptr_lo`](../tables.md#room_map_ptr_lo)
